validity._comment: Measurement validity policy (codegreen_runtime.measurement_validity / run_validity). Windows are counted in sampler readings; a resolution is the slowest selected provider's update_interval_ms (a provider fact) or the sampler interval. gap_policy is keyed by sampler.marker_reads: interpolated (NEMB markers interpolate between readings, so a starved sampler is fatal SAMPLER_STARVED) and last_poll (the Java standalone poller's markers read the last polled counter, so a gap is the warning SAMPLER_GAP and widens per-function resolution, while a failed read leaves a stale counter: fatal PROVIDER_READ_FAILED). severity values: fatal or warning. Per-function quality: measured, aggregate_only (summed time spans aggregate_min_factor resolutions), below_resolution. min_run_updates: a `codegreen run` mean duration below this many resolutions is RUN_BELOW_RESOLUTION. fail_on_invalid: exit 3 on any fatal reason (measure, run, project).

run_path._comment: codegreen run reads energy synchronously at each run boundary; the NEMB background sampler only has to outpace counter wrap there, so it is slowed to sampler_interval_ms to cut its wakeups (kept at the coordinator interval when a GPU domain reports, since GPU energy is power-integrated from the samples).

toolchain._comment: Compilers for instrumented C/C++ (codegreen measure). Env CC/CXX override c/cpp; names resolve in prefer_dirs before PATH, and the compile runs with the compiler's directory first on PATH so its own ld/as are used.

measurement._default_sensors_comment: --sensors and default_sensors names -> NEMB registry providers. A sensor is satisfied by the first of its providers that initializes (CODEGREEN_PROVIDERS alternatives a|b); default_sensors "all" sums every provider that initializes, or a list of sensor names selects them strictly. nemb.providers.<name>.enabled false removes a provider from every selection.

line_sampler._comment: codegreen.analysis.line_sampling: py-spy line-level CPU samples on a profiled run only. record: py-spy arguments before --rate; flags: always on; feature_flags: in-run features a caller switches on by name (native: C-extension frames); pass_flags: extra profiled runs (idle: waiting threads included, gil: GIL holder only). frame_re matches one collapsed frame (groups func, file, line; no match = native), library_re a library file, irreducible_re library or native frames a source rewrite cannot remove. interpreter_re finds the interpreter word of the workload command for the tracemalloc run (alloc_*).

codegreen.analysis.line_sampling and the Java event sampler (codegreen.analysis.sampling). Line samples: async-profiler JFR at rate_hz converted by jfrconv --lines; async_profiler: release directory (empty: $CODEGREEN_ASYNC_PROFILER); flags: JVM options loaded with the agent (DebugNonSafepoints gives accurate lines inside compiled code). frame_re matches one collapsed frame (groups file = the class, func, optional line; an optional JIT annotation is dropped; a shared object or C++ frame is native), file_replace turns '/' class separators into '.', library_re marks JDK classes. No irreducible_re is declared.

monitor._comment: Long-running Monitor knobs. Config-driven, no magic numbers in code. Defaults match the v0.4.9 behavior except for the bounded in-memory buffer and rotation, which are noise-reduction features for always-on use.

attribution._comment: Per-process energy share. cgroup_v2 reads cpu.stat (usage_usec); cgroup_v1 reads cpuacct.usage (ns); cpu_percent uses psutil. auto picks the most accurate available backend at start(). Order: cgroup_v2 > cgroup_v1 > cpu_percent.

exporters._comment: External sink configuration. Each sink reads its own subtree. CLI flag `--exporter NAME` enables a sink (repeatable). OTLP requires `pip install codegreen[otlp]`; missing deps fail loud at start() — no silent no-op. Cardinality bound for OTLP labels = monitor.annotation.max_labels (single source of truth).

prometheus._comment: Prometheus pull endpoint (Sink ABC, D5). Default bind is loopback for privacy; set listen_addr to expose externally + use auth_token for compliance. Optional dependency: `pip install codegreen[prometheus]`. Label cardinality is capped UPSTREAM by monitor.annotation.max_labels.

remote_push._comment: PLACEHOLDER for todo.txt Q1 (remote agent-to-server push). Distinct from OTLP: direct fleet-telemetry batch protocol.

hotspot_taxonomy._comment: Per-verdict thresholds for `codegreen project`'s per-function classifier. OCP-compliant: each verdict is a self-contained block; new verdicts can be added without touching dispatch code. Defaults match the historical hardcoded thresholds at codegreen/cli/cli.py:3424-3435 prior to extraction. CodeGreen detects wrapper / TYPE_1_DIRECT / TYPE_2_INEFFICIENT / TYPE_5_FREQUENCY / minor; TYPE_3_INDIRECT and TYPE_4_STRUCTURAL require callgraph analysis and are deferred to the consuming agent.

hw_counters._comment: CPU hardware counters (codegreen.analysis.hwcounters); perf: the perf binary every counter and event-sampler run uses. Perf event names per architecture live in codegreen/hw_events/*.json. attribution: logical events sampled with call stacks, one extra non-measured run each; the value is the number of events between samples (a prime, so samples do not lock step with loops).

gpu_metrics._comment: codegreen.analysis.gpu_metrics on profiled runs only: series_interval_ms of the device series, ncu replay counters (launch_count kernels), roofline.latency_pct set a priori (a kernel whose DRAM and SM speed-of-light shares both stay under it is latency/launch bound). peaks: per-device datasheet values {device name: {dram_gbps, fp32_tflops, source}}, host data declared in the user config; none ship here.
